job_hypothesis: Install a full kitchen fast with zero callbacks
name: Derek Simmons
behaviors: Owns a 4-person crew doing 3 or 4 kitchens a week
Personally checks every cabinet run because he doesn't trust his apprentices with level yet
A callback costs him half a day
values: A crew that works without him
current_alternatives: A self-leveling laser to set a reference line across the run
Shimming each cabinet to the laser line
Doing the final level check himself
objections: The laser already gives the crew a reference line
The hard skill isn't reading a level; it's knowing how to shim an uneven floor
Gear on his sites gets dropped, lost and covered in dust
He'd need to watch an apprentice get a full run right alone before he'd stop checking
